contractName: Nala Landslide Risk Model V1 Contract

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude coordinate in Himachal Pradesh

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude coordinate in Himachal Pradesh

slope_deg.description: Topographic slope angle. Primary static shear stress driver.

tri.description: Terrain Ruggedness Index. Represents gully incision and talus exposure.

rainfall_1d_mm.description: Daily precipitation downpour triggering pore-water pressure spikes.

rainfall_3d_mm.description: 3-day antecedent precipitation sum inducing soil saturation.

normalization.slope: Geomorphological piecewise: [0 deg->0.0, 10 deg->0.10, 20 deg->0.35, 32 deg->0.85, 42 deg->1.00, 60 deg->0.80]

amplificationRule.description: Critical colluvium shear failure: if slope >= 22.0 deg AND rain_1d >= 64.4 mm, score receives +0.12 * (f_slope * f_rain)

MEDIUM.action: Advisory warning; vulnerable road cuts and debris fans on alert.

HIGH.action: Evacuation and closure warning; imminent debris flows and rockfall expected.

confidencePolicy.description: Reflects observational data completeness independently from risk score.
